public_positioning.short: A second look before important action.
public_positioning.summary: Active Mirror helps people, families, schools, founders, and teams check risky messages, understand confusing material, write clearer messages, make calmer decisions, and create useful business videos.
public_positioning.vision: A world where people pause before the wrong action and move faster on the right one.
public_positioning.mission: Give every important moment a useful second look.
public_positioning.promise: Plain English first, with human review where money, safety, school, policy, public claims, or brand risk matter.
audiences: People and families checking online risk
Students, teachers, parents, schools, and training teams
Founders, local businesses, and business teams
Organizations that need approved material turned into useful business video
